title: Homelab Overview
description: Home dashboard for tiny-dgx: node, unified memory, Kubernetes, Longhorn and MinIO.

options.content:
### 🏔️ The Last Node Standing
`tiny-dgx` · single-node k3s · Longhorn → MinIO backups · memory is shared by CPU **and** GPU, so every gigabyte counts.

panels.title: Memory available
panels.description: Unified memory (CPU + GPU) still available to new work

panels.title: GPU reserve headroom
panels.description: Available memory minus the 8 GiB bnn gpusched keeps free. Below zero, background GPU jobs are not admitted.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Warning and critical alerts (info-level alerts are listed below)

panels.title: Memory available vs GPU reserve
panels.description: Red band: below 4 GiB (OOM risk). Orange band: below the 8 GiB gpusched reserve.

panels.title: Memory by namespace
panels.description: Working set of Kubernetes pods only; Docker containers and host processes (model servers) are not included.

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Inbound above the axis, outbound below.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Reads above the axis, writes below.

panels.title: Longhorn volume usage
panels.description: Actual data written as a share of each volume's size

panels.title: Longhorn throughput
panels.description: Reads above the axis, writes below.

panels.title: MinIO S3 traffic
panels.description: Backups written above the axis, restores below.
